title: Daxor to Showcase Blood Volume Analysis Platform at ASN Kidney Week 2026
summary: Making its ASN debut, Daxor’s BVA™ technology delivers precise volume measurement to optimize fluid management and improve complex kidney care.
body_markdown:
Making its ASN debut, Daxor’s BVA™ technology delivers precise volume measurement to optimize fluid management and improve complex kidney care.


**Key Highlights:**


- Commercial Presence: Daxor exhibiting at **Booth #390** during ASN Kidney Week 2026 in Denver, CO (October 21–25, 2026).
- Clinical Focus: Highlighting Blood Volume Analysis (BVA) to address critical fluid overload, cardiorenal syndrome, and dialysis volume management challenges.
- Global Reach: Engaging with international nephrology leaders to advance data-driven precision medicine for patients with renal disease.


**OAK RIDGE, Tenn. – October 13, 2026** –[Daxor Corporation](https://daxor.com/) (Nasdaq: DXR), the global leader in blood volume measurement technology, announced today it will exhibit at the American Society of Nephrology (ASN) 59th Annual Meeting and Scientific Exposition (Kidney Week 2026) at the Colorado Convention Center in Denver, Colorado, from October 21–25, 2026.


ASN Kidney Week is the largest and most influential international gathering of kidney professionals in the world, bringing together experts dedicated to improving care for more than 850 million people worldwide living with kidney disease. The Scientific Exposition showcases the latest advances in treatment, research, and cutting-edge medical technology across the nephrology community.


Attendees are invited to visit Booth #390 to experience Daxor’s FDA-cleared, lab-based diagnostic BVA platform, which directly measures total blood, red blood cell and plasma volume. In complex renal care, including cardiorenal syndrome, end-stage renal disease (ESRD), and acute kidney injury (AKI)—traditional surrogates like weight changes, clinical exams, and laboratory markers often fail to accurately reflect intravascular fluid status. BVA provides lab-accurate, actionable metrics enabling safer volume unloading while avoiding dangerous fluid shifts.


“Managing fluid balance is one of the most critical challenges in nephrology,” said **John L. Jefferies, MD, MPH, MBA** , Chief Medical Officer of Daxor. “BVA provides nephrologists with exact, objective volume data, replacing subjective estimations with precision measurement to optimize patient care in both inpatient and outpatient settings.”


Daxor’s team will be on site to provide live platform overviews, discuss clinical integration, and review reimbursement pathways.


To learn more about[ASN Kidney Week 2026](https://www.asn-online.org/education/kidneyweek/) or schedule a direct meeting with Daxor representatives,[contact us here](https://daxor.com/contact-us/) .


**About Daxor Corporation**


Daxor Corporation (NASDAQ: DXR) is tackling healthcare’s “multi-billion-dollar silent crisis” – the inability to precisely measure blood volume. This often results in suboptimal care, prolonged hospital stays, and increased readmissions for many high-cost medical conditions like heart failure and those requiring ICU care. With 50 years of experience and innovation, Daxor is proud to manufacture and distribute its patented, FDA-cleared Blood Volume Analysis (BVA) diagnostic which offers unmatched, real-time, precise data via its rapid, hand-held, lab-based system. This empowers clinicians to make individualized treatment decisions that significantly improve patient outcomes and deliver substantial efficiencies in value-based healthcare. Daxor is ISO certified and operates a U.S.-based, 20,000-square-foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility, positioning the company for accelerated market expansion.


For more information, please visit our website at[Daxor.com](https://daxor.com/) .
